release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.1 Unified ADAPT Import, Export Elongation Persistence & Dynamic Block ID Scaling:
• Unified Top-Bar ADAPT Report Import: Consolidated ADAPT report importing into a single action beside Fast CAD Export in the top command bar. A single upload simultaneously refreshes the 2D CAD plan, profile elevation viewer, inspector properties panel, schedule tables, and export datasets.
• Full Export Elongation Persistence: Fixed export issue where exported AutoCAD drawings (DWG/DXF) and tables reverted to theoretical values instead of preserving imported ADAPT elongations. Both CAD drawings and takeoff schedules strictly retain imported ADAPT values.
• Dynamic Tendon ID Block Scaling: Removed manual text height override from Settings. Tendon ID bubble blocks (BLOQUE1) take attribute text heights directly from the template DWG definition or scale naturally with bubble ID size (tag_bubble_radius_mm).
